about.label: About
about.title: Coffee is a ritual for us.
about.p1: Marcella Coffee in Nilüfer, Bursa sees coffee not just as a drink, but as a meeting place. In our space designed in black and cream tones, we prepare every cup with care.
about.p2: Whether heading to work in the morning or meeting friends in the evening — feel at home at Marcella.
